# The licences of the packages the first preview restores are reviewed and listed
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #369, sha256:97265400699d778948e7fc747f30f42c4c5d95f1de26ac024c3936afba971a60). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** story
- **Repository:** avowry (docs/release)
- **Source:** product-owner answers to the nine owner items on docs/release/pre-publication-checks.md, inbox entry of 2026-11-08 (card 186). Ranked before the v0.1 publish card.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want the licences of every package that the preview restores, direct or transitive, to be listed, so that I know the preview's dependency licences are compatible with Apache-2.0.
- **Consumer value:** Dana can see every restored package's licence on one page before she adopts the preview.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S] every restored package is listed
     Given a clean restore of the solution
     When the restored packages are read
     Then a page lists each package with its version and licence, and says how the list was produced
  2. Scenario: [Z][B] an incompatible licence is flagged
     Given the list
     When a package has a licence that conflicts with Apache-2.0 or has none
     Then the page names it with a recommendation; when none does, it says so
  3. Scenario: [I] the list is checked
     Given the lockfile or the restore output
     When a test compares it with the page
     Then a package missing from the page fails the test
- **Not in this card:** Changing any dependency; legal advice.
- **Size:** M
